summary: Backend-only review (Jan 2026): /api/users/search advanced filters, /api/notifications unread + mark-read, /api/matches/{id} typing/peer-state/read. 13/13 pytest tests pass after a single bug fix on the music filter (MongoDB $regex-inside-$in error).

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: passing [{'$regex': t, '$options': 'i'}] inside {'$in': ...} raised pymongo OperationFailure 'cannot nest $ under $in' → HTTP 500. Replaced with re.compile(re.escape(t), IGNORECASE) so BSON regex objects are used inside $in.

rca_of_issue: GET /api/users/search?music=techno,house returned 500. RCA: MongoDB rejects `{'$in': [{'$regex': 't', '$options': 'i'}]}` with 'cannot nest $ under $in'. Only compiled regex (Python re.Pattern / bson.regex.Regex) is allowed inside $in. Fix: build list with `[re.compile(re.escape(t), re.IGNORECASE) for t in tags]`. Verified with pytest — all filters (music, combined city+age+music) now succeed.
